goal: Validate the work-order contract fixtures and report deterministic proof outcomes.
constraints: Stay within the work-order validator and fixture surfaces.
Do not implement the upward claims/evidence contract.

claims_to_produce.statement: The golden fixture passes and seeded-invalid fixtures fail with actionable errors.
The work_order.schema.json artifact documents budget and proof obligation fields.

proof_obligations.check: Schema required fields include claims_to_produce, proof_obligations, stop_conditions, and budget.

stop_conditions: Stop if any seeded-invalid fixture validates successfully.
Stop if validator errors omit code, path, or message.
